servers.name: feishu
servers._authentication: Runs the official lark-mcp image via Docker (ghcr.io/larksuite/lark-mcp). The two `-e` flags forward the App ID / App Secret from the process env (injected from setup.feishuAppId / setup.feishuAppSecret). The image and tag are placeholders matching the public larksuite/lark-mcp project — verify the exact distribution and tag before enabling this server. If a stdio binary distribution is preferred, swap command/args accordingly.
